prev_season.note: Back-tested replay, not a live record: the model was frozen after this season (as of 2026-04-16) and replayed walk-forward over it. These games are inside the model's TEST window. Every forecast is EARLY tier (team ratings only). Numbers as published on the site (site payload of 2026-09-14, commit db82bb29); frozen, never recomputed.

model_card.baseline_def: a logistic fit on the Elo term alone, fit on 2011-12 to 2017-18 like the model and scored on the same TEST games
